settings.heading: Jessica
settings.text: The heart behind Southern Bloom Bakery Co.

settings.name: Baked with love
settings.subheading:
Every cookie tells
a little story
settings.text:
Southern Bloom Bakery Co. started with a simple idea: that the sweetest moments deserve something just as beautiful to celebrate them with.

Every order is hand-iced in my kitchen, one cookie at a time. I take the time to match your colours, your theme and the little details that make your celebration yours.

settings.heading: Made with love
settings.text: Every set is decorated by hand, never mass produced, and never rushed.

settings.heading: As good as they look
settings.text: Soft, buttery sugar cookies with a smooth royal icing finish.

settings.heading: Designed with you
settings.text: Your colours, your theme, your details. We design your set together.

settings.heading: Tell me your vision
settings.text: Send your date, colours, theme and quantity through the order form.

settings.heading: We design together
settings.text: I'll come back with ideas, a quote and a design plan for your set.

settings.heading: Pick up and celebrate
settings.text: Your cookies are hand-iced fresh and packaged ready to gift or serve.

settings.heading: Your celebration deserves cookies as beautiful as the moment.
